import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Pairwise scatter plot (top-left): Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5,
                color=colors[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal scatter plot (top-right): Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5,
                color=colors[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot comparison (bottom-left): All measurements by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
data_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', 
                      value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                      var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
data_melted['Measurement'] = data_melted['Measurement'].str.replace('_', ' ').str.title()

sns.boxplot(data=data_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
            ax=ax3, palette=colors, width=0.6)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements across Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot (bottom-right): Petal length distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
species_order = ['setosa', 'versicolor', 'virginica']
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == s]['petal_length'].values for s in species_order],
                        positions=[0, 1, 2], widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)

for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[species_order[i]])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')
    pc.set_linewidth(1.5)

parts['cmeans'].set_edgecolor('darkred')
parts['cmeans'].set_linewidth(2)
parts['cmedians'].set_edgecolor('darkblue')
parts['cmedians'].set_linewidth(2)

ax4.set_xticks([0, 1, 2])
ax4.set_xticklabels(species_order)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
